newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU BOURSE INDEX ADDS RIGA SHIPYARD.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU BOURSE INDEX ADDS RIGA SHIPYARD.

text.p: Rietumu Bank on Monday said that its Latvian bourse index composition has changed with the addition of Riga Shipyard and is therefore not directly comparable to its index for the last session.
The bank said in a statment that its Rietumu index came to 186.75 points, including the Riga Shipyard.
The bank also said that both its indices, Rietumu and the blue-chip tracking Rietumu 16, did not take into account closed share issues.
"Until bonus share issues are registered in the central depository, the calculation of bourse indices cannot take them into account," tha bank said.
"In shareholders' meetings in March and April.. several companies decided to pay bonus shares instead of dividends and others decided to capitalise their debts," Rietumu Bank said.

Shareholders of leading bank Unibanka, an official list stock, earlier decided on a bonus share issue, which still has to be approved by the securities commission and the central bank and registered in the depository.
Lode Brick factory shareholders also decided on a bonus payment.
